findings.title: Portfolio page now shows cash, total equity and an as-of banner for both the ledger and pricing dates
findings.observed: After session 1's three buys, /portfolio's summary tiles read CASH $4,459.86, TOTAL EQUITY $10,153.68 (labeled 'positions + cash'), MARKET VALUE $5,693.82 (3 priced) and COST BASIS $5,540.14. A banner above the tiles reads 'Ledger as of 2026-07-13 Â· priced at the close of 2026-08-14'.
findings.expected: Cash and total equity on the same screen as positions, with an as-of for both the ledger date and the pricing date -- previously this endpoint had neither field.
findings.why_it_matters: Step 3 of my process (size) needs deployable cash and total equity in one place before I decide the next clip; I closed the session knowing exactly how much dry powder remains.

findings.title: Portfolio page now exposes settled vs unsettled cash by account, with the derivation window stated
findings.observed: The 'Cash by account' table for uat-taxable shows SETTLED $4,459.86 / UNSETTLED $0.00 / BALANCE $4,459.86, SOURCE 'derived 2026-07-10 -> 2026-07-13', with a footnote that the window is the export's coverage, not necessarily the account's whole history.
findings.expected: A settled/unsettled split so I know what I can actually redeploy same-day without violating the no-reuse-of-unsettled-proceeds rule.
findings.why_it_matters: I have not sold anything yet this week, so this only proves the field exists and is zero when it should be zero; I will re-check the split after session 2's first sale, when unsettled should go non-zero.

findings.title: /rules page now exists and unknown routes get a real, self-describing 404
findings.observed: /rules loads a dedicated page: the 12-rule catalog with expressions and descriptions, plus a live expression tester, reachable from the top nav without first picking a symbol. Guessing a bad route (/screener) renders 'Not found -- Nothing is routed at /screener' plus a list of all nine real routes with a one-line description each.
findings.expected: A discoverable rules page and a real 404 that names the bad path rather than a silent redirect to /portfolio.
findings.why_it_matters: This was the difference between 'the feature does not exist' and 'the feature is one unadvertised scroll deep' -- it is now neither, it is on the nav bar.

findings.title: Decision table's significance rating now carries an explained legend with thresholds and sample-size caveats
findings.observed: On /ticker/SPY and /ticker/XLE, each rule row's SAMPLE column reads 'raw (independent)', e.g. '125 (41 indep)', and SIGNIFICANCE is suggestive/weak/insufficient. Expanding 'How significance is graded' states: suggestive needs at least 30 independent triggers and a hit rate at least 8 points from baseline; weak needs at least 8 independent and 15 points; both conditions must hold together; and explicitly: 'Not a significance test ... a table of twenty rules is twenty simultaneous tests with no correction between them. See the Backtest scan for one that corrects for the family.'
findings.expected: A stated threshold and sample size behind any rating word, and an explicit statement of what the rating is not (a corrected significance test) -- both present now.
findings.why_it_matters: I will not act on a 'suggestive' rating I cannot reconstruct; this is now reconstructable and honestly hedged, which is exactly what keeps a computation from reading as advice.

findings.title: Report's Current Drawdown now reports the live gap to peak, not the episode trough
findings.observed: /report/SPY's 'Drawdown profile' card shows 'Current drawdown (close basis) 0.2%, peak 2026-08-13 -> trough 2026-08-14, 1 bar(s)+ (ongoing) underwater'. The Facts table separately carries 'Current drawdown -0.2%' and 'Current episode worst -0.2%' as two distinct rows, both with an as-of.
findings.expected: 'Current drawdown' answers how far below the peak the instrument is today, not how bad the ongoing episode got at its worst -- both figures present and separately labeled now.
findings.why_it_matters: I size stops off the live gap to peak, not off a historical trough; conflating the two would have had me sizing a stop against a number that no longer describes where the price is.

findings.title: Report Facts table no longer conflates the deepest episode's 'still underwater' with the live current drawdown
findings.observed: The Facts table's 'Deepest episode still underwater: no' row is clearly scoped to the deepest historical episode (2007-10-09 -> 2009-03-09), separate from the 'Current drawdown -0.2%' / 'Current episode worst -0.2%' rows. No contradictory pair on screen.
findings.expected: Two different episodes should not share one ambiguous label -- they are now named 'Deepest episode' vs 'Current' throughout.
findings.why_it_matters: Same root cause as the prior item: I read this table quickly between sessions and a mislabeled pair reads as a system that contradicts itself in four seconds.

findings.title: Fear & Greed Score column is now explicitly labeled 'not published by CNN' rather than silently empty
findings.observed: The component table's header carries: 'CNN publishes each component's raw value and rating, but not the 0-100 normalisation behind them' and 'not published by CNN' directly over the Score column. Every row's Score cell reads an em-dash consistent with that explanation. Raw values now carry units and a one-line description per component, e.g. 'Stock Price Strength -- stocks at 52-week highs relative to those at 52-week lows -- 0.75 ratio -- Fear'.
findings.expected: Absent data should say why it is absent at the point it is displayed, not just be blank -- it does now.
findings.why_it_matters: An unexplained blank column reads as a bug; a labeled one reads as an honest limit of the upstream source, which is the distinction my mandate cares about most (partial data labelled, not hidden).

findings.title: Activity page now shows buys as well as sells, with provenance per row
findings.observed: /activity lists all 4 session-1 ledger rows: Buy SPY 3 @ $752.85, Buy QQQ 3 @ $718.08, Buy XLV 7 @ $161.05, and the $10,000.00 ACH deposit -- each with an import/source-row coordinate (e.g. 'ad4176ec:0 Â· Buy'). BOUGHT $5,540.14 / SOLD $0.00 / NET CASH FLOW $4,459.86 tiles agree with the paper broker's own book to the cent.
findings.expected: Every transaction, buys included, walkable back to its source row -- present now.
findings.why_it_matters: Provenance is this tool's stated premise; a ledger that only shows sales is not a ledger I can reconcile against my own fill records.

findings.title: Empty-ledger onboarding points to a working Activity/Import page instead of a bare 'data/' instruction
findings.observed: /portfolio with the sandbox's ledger still empty (before session 1's fills) read: 'No positions yet -- the ledger is empty. Copy your broker exports into data/ and import them from the Activity page; Robinhood, Webull and SoFi are detected by header signature.'
findings.expected: An onboarding message that names a concrete next action and a page that actually does it -- both present.
findings.why_it_matters: A blank panel with no path forward is a dead end for a new user; this one tells you exactly where to go.

findings.title: Rule grammar's unknown-field hint now correctly points to indicator call syntax
findings.observed: Typing 'sma20 > sma50' into the /rules expression tester returns 'NOT VALID: unknown price field 'sma20' -- did you mean sma(20)? Indicators take their parameters in parentheses, not glued to the name.' The catalog lists all 12 rules with working call-syntax expressions (sma(200), rsi(14), bb_lower(20,2), etc.), and the input's own placeholder ('rsi(14) < 30 and close > sma(200)') parses cleanly.
findings.expected: A rejection message that teaches the correct form rather than implying indicators do not exist.
findings.why_it_matters: I abandoned indicator-based rules on my first try in an earlier trial run of this kind of tool; this message would not have caused that this time.
